frozen: 2026-07-28 — Hermes ablation design. Sections identical per tool; no examples; no target-specific hints. Written BLIND: derived from function signatures and observed CLI behaviour, never from find-40 content and never from @serves/@does header prose.

tool_a.purpose: Ranks repository files by relevance to a natural-language question, weighting rare terms over common ones.
tool_a.inputs: question (string, required); top (integer, optional, default 5 — maximum results).
tool_a.outputs: JSON array of repo-relative file paths, most relevant first. Paths only; no scores.
tool_a.failure_behaviour: Returns an empty array when no file scores above zero.

tool_b.purpose: Searches several local indexes at once — full-text documents, a code-structure graph, and a registry of declared mechanisms — and merges their matches into one answer.
tool_b.inputs: query (string, required — a task or question); top (integer, optional — maximum matches kept per index).
tool_b.outputs: One section per index, each listing matching file paths with a short excerpt or the reason it matched.
tool_b.failure_behaviour: Prints empty sections when no index has a match.

tool_c.purpose: Finds registered mechanisms whose declared function matches a described need.
tool_c.inputs: need (string, required — a description of what you want to accomplish).
tool_c.outputs: Ranked list of matching entries with their file paths and declared purposes.
tool_c.failure_behaviour: Prints an empty result when no entry matches.

tool_d.purpose: Runs ranked full-text search over a local document corpus.
tool_d.inputs: query (string, required); top (integer, optional — maximum results).
tool_d.outputs: Ranked list of matching documents with scores and excerpts.
tool_d.failure_behaviour: Prints no results when no document matches.

tool_e.purpose: Finds files by literal text content or by file-name pattern.
tool_e.inputs: operation (string, required — "content" to search inside files, "name" to match file names); pattern (string, required — literal text, regex, or name pattern); scope (path, optional — where to look).
tool_e.outputs: Matching file paths; for content search, the matching lines as well.
tool_e.failure_behaviour: Prints nothing and exits non-zero when there are no matches; rejects an unknown operation with a usage error.
